verdict.rationale: A tax-filing portal could plausibly offer AI-generated insights or suggestions, so the axis applies, but the evidence pack shows no such capability. The closest items are adjacent features rather than AI insights: MeinELSTER+ automatically creating tax returns (elster-docs-9), a guided step-by-step flow (elster-docs-10), and receipt upload or photo capture (elster-docs-11, elster-docs-12). None of these mention AI analysis or suggestions drawn from the user's data.
